name: Now Playing
description: Writes what is on air to data/now-playing.json (and optionally a webhook), plus a public /api/v1/x/now-playing endpoint for overlays and websites.
author: nodecast

settingsSchema.label: JSON file
settingsSchema.help: Written on every track change — point OBS or a website at it.

settingsSchema.label: Text file
settingsSchema.help: One line, "artist — title", for a scrolling sign or an OBS text source.

settingsSchema.label: Webhook
settingsSchema.help: POSTed the same payload whenever the track changes.
